categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py, which is explicitly covered under seed generation.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled IndexError when parsing 11-field seeder lines during seed generation. As noted in the description, 'parseline() intended to skip malformed or incomplete lines but only checked len(sline) < 11 while later accessing sline[11]', causing the script to abort rather than skip the line; seed generation is an important release tool, but this edge-case crash is easily deferred.
